item.title: The AI Golden Age: Only Neutron Star Collisions of AI Can Birth Golden Companies
item.description: Gold isn't mined from the earth—it's forged when neutron stars collide. The AI Golden Age is the same: only the violent collision between AI and traditional industries can birth companies as precious as gold.
